content_sections.heading: CARI Consultant Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the CARI Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download CARI Consultant Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Consultant : Post graduate in Ayurveda - MD(Ay)/MS(Ay) from a recognized university OR B.A.M.S. from a recognized university. Minimum 05 (Five) years post qualification experience preferably from a Govt organization (for B.A.M.S. candidates).

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for CARI Consultant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Central Ayurveda Research Institute (CARI) for filling up vacant positions on a contract basis in New Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post being offered?
faq.answer: The position available in this recruitment drive is Consultant (Ayurveda) under the research field for qualified and experienced medical professionals.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Consultant (Ayurveda) position under this recruitment notification released by CARI.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is completely offline through a Walk-in Interview. Interested candidates do not need to submit any online applications.

faq.question: Q5. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview along with the written test is scheduled to be conducted on 15-10-2026 at the designated interview venue.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required qualification for the Consultant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post graduate degree in Ayurveda such as MD(Ay)/MS(Ay) or B.A.M.S. with a minimum of 5 years of post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the upper age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is set at 64 years. Candidates exceeding this age limit will not be considered for the position.

faq.question: Q8. What is the monthly salary offered?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 50,000/- for rendering their services on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring all original certificates for verification, two recent passport size photographs, self-attested photocopies of certificates, and a No Objection Certificate if employed.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for CARI Consultant recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the shortlisted candidates appearing for the walk-in drive comprises a written test followed by a personal interview.
